rationale: Price and momentum lead on-chain; when the weekly Wave Trend (cipherb_weekly) hits extremes it has marked every major top and bottom in the dataset, so it anchors 40% of the index. The daily version (25%) catches divergences faster — when the daily collapses while the weekly is still elevated it fires a pre-emptive exit, avoiding the worst of mid-cycle corrections like early 2022. Mayer (20%) adds a price-to-200DMA reality check, with non-linear breakpoints that compress the rare extreme-undervalue zone (<0.8) into a very low risk score and accelerate into danger above 2.0. Pi-cycle gap (15%) is treated with a steep piecewise curve: once the gap closes below 5% the risk score spikes to 80+, reflecting the historically precise top signal when 111DMA approaches 350DMAx2. Thresholds are slightly asymmetric — sell at 78 rather than 80 — because tops are cleaner (all three oscillators align simultaneously) than bottoms, where the 2022 bear market repeatedly faked recoveries; the low 2-day confirmation window keeps me fast on exits and entries when a clean momentum signal fires.
